why: Одну и ту же мысль можно сказать по-разному в зависимости от того, с кем вы говорите: с другом, коллегой или клиентом. В русском это «ты» и «вы», в английском их нет, и регистр передаётся выбором слов, контракций и структур. Если написать клиенту как другу (Hey, gimme the file!), это прозвучит грубо; если другу написать как в официальном письме, это прозвучит холодно и странно.
formation: • Неформальный: сокращения (I'm, can't, gonna), короткие фразы, фразовые глаголы (put off, look into), простые слова, междометия (hey, cheers).
• Формальный: полные формы (I am, cannot), более длинные слова латинского происхождения (postpone, investigate), пассив, вежливые конструкции (Would you mind..., I would be grateful if...).
• Нейтральный регистр — между ними, подходит для большинства рабочих чатов.
usage: • Неформально: Can you send me the file? (Отправь мне файл.)
• Формально: Could you possibly send me the file? / Would you mind sending me the file? (Не могли бы вы отправить мне файл?)
2. Слова: фразовый глагол в разговоре, а в письме — одно слово.

• find out — determine; put off — postpone; turn down — decline; look into — investigate; set up — establish; go up — increase; carry out — conduct; fill in — complete; get — obtain; ask for — request; tell — inform; need — require; buy — purchase; help — assist
• Неформально: Hi Tom, / Hey guys, ... Cheers, / See you! / Thanks a bunch!
• Формально: Dear Mr. Smith, / Dear Sir or Madam, ... Yours sincerely, (если знаете имя) / Yours faithfully, (если не знаете) / Kind regards,
• I am writing to enquire about... / regarding... (Пишу, чтобы узнать о... / по поводу...)
• Please find the report attached. (Во вложении вы найдёте отчёт.)
• I apologize for the delay. (Приношу извинения за задержку.)
• Unfortunately, we are unable to... (К сожалению, мы не можем...)
• Thank you for your assistance. (Благодарю за помощь.)
signalWords: Формальные: regarding, furthermore, therefore, would like to, I would appreciate, kindly. Неформальные: hey, guys, stuff, kind of, gotta, cheers, no worries, ASAP.
mistakes: ✗ Dear Mr. Smith, Hi! Can u send the docs? → ✓ Dear Mr. Smith, Could you please send the documents? (смесь регистров в одном письме)
✗ I want a refund. → ✓ I would like to request a refund. (want звучит слишком резко)
✗ I'm writing to you for ask information → ✓ I am writing to enquire about... (после writing to нужен глагол без for)
✗ Yours faithfully, Mr. Smith (письмо начиналось с Dear Mr. Smith) → ✓ Yours sincerely, (faithfully только после Dear Sir or Madam)
✗ We can't accept it (в формальном контракте) → ✓ We cannot accept it
remember: Чем дальше собеседник и выше ставки, тем длиннее слова, полнее формы и мягче просьба.

items.prompt: (a) Could you possibly tell me where the office is? (b) Where's the office?
(a) I'm writing to ask about the job. (b) I am writing to enquire about the position.
(a) Thanks a bunch! (b) Thank you very much.
(a) Hi guys, (b) Dear Sir or Madam,
(a) We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful. (b) Sorry, but you didn't get the job.
(a) Cheers, (b) Yours faithfully,
(a) I would appreciate your prompt reply. (b) Write back ASAP!
(a) We cannot accept this proposal. (b) We can't accept this proposal.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте формальное слово вместо неформального (в скобках)

items.prompt: We need to ___ (get) approval from the manager.
Please ___ (tell) us of any changes to your address.
I would like to ___ (ask for) a refund.
This position ___ (need) at least three years of experience.
We will ___ (start) the project in March.
Our team will ___ (help) you with the installation.
The company intends to ___ (buy) a new building.
Thank you for your ___ (help).

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение в формальном регистре, используя подсказку

items.prompt: Can you send me your CV? (Would you mind...)
items.answer: Would you mind sending me your CV?

items.prompt: I want to book a room. (I would like...)
items.answer: I would like to book a room.

items.prompt: Tell me the price. (Could you...)
items.answer: Could you tell me the price? / Could you please tell me the price?

items.prompt: Sorry I'm late. (I apologize for...)
Thanks for your help. (...your assistance)
We can't give you a refund. (Unfortunately, we are unable...)
items.answer: Unfortunately, we are unable to give you a refund. / Unfortunately, we are unable to provide you with a refund.

items.prompt: What's your phone number? (Could you give me...)
items.answer: Could you give me your phone number? / Could you give me your phone number, please?

items.prompt: I'm writing about my order. (regarding)
items.answer: I am writing regarding my order.

exercises.instruction: Замените фразовый глагол на более формальное слово (в скобках)

items.prompt: We had to put off the meeting. (postpone)
items.answer: We had to postpone the meeting.

items.prompt: The manager turned down my request. (decline)
We will look into the problem. (investigate)
The company set up a new branch. (establish)
items.answer: The company established a new branch.

items.prompt: Prices have gone up this year. (increase)
They carried out a survey. (conduct)
Please fill in the form. (complete)
The engineers found out the cause. (determine)
Не могли бы вы отправить мне договор до пятницы?
items.answer: Could you send me the contract by Friday? / Would you be able to send me the contract by Friday?

items.prompt: Привет! Как дела? Давно не виделись.
items.answer: Hi! How's it going? Long time no see. / Hi! How are you? Long time no see.

items.prompt: Прошу прощения за задержку с ответом.
items.answer: I apologize for the delay in replying. / I apologize for the delay in my response.

items.prompt: Мне надо бежать, увидимся позже!
items.answer: I gotta run, see you later! / I have to run, see you later!

items.prompt: Я пишу, чтобы узнать о вакансии разработчика.
items.answer: I am writing to enquire about the developer position. / I am writing to inquire about the developer position.

items.prompt: К сожалению, мы вынуждены отклонить ваше предложение.
items.answer: Unfortunately, we are unable to accept your offer. / Unfortunately, we have to decline your offer.

items.prompt: Эй, не мог бы ты помочь мне с этим багом?
items.answer: Hey, could you help me with this bug? / Hey, can you help me with this bug?

items.prompt: Во вложении вы найдёте отчёт.
items.answer: Please find the report attached. / Please find attached the report.
